COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), organization/presentation (structured coordinate set as current representation) and a separate origin/status field are all present for p0/current/n2.

C.rationale: Report explicitly lists identified content (colour 'red') with coordinate attribute for a named record.

D.rationale: The report separates content identification (red coordinates) from a distinct origin/status field for the same referent.

O.rationale: The coordinate set shows how the content is presented/organized in the record (a 2x2 block at specified coordinates) and is marked as current.
